theme: Kể về dự án đáng nhớ

vocab.meaning_vi: dẫn dắt một nhóm làm việc
vocab.example: It was the first time I had to lead a team of four developers.
vocab.example_vi: Đó là lần đầu tiên tôi phải dẫn dắt một nhóm bốn lập trình viên.

vocab.meaning_vi: những bài học rút ra sau dự án
vocab.example: One of the lessons learned was to plan for risk much earlier.
vocab.example_vi: Một trong những bài học rút ra là phải tính đến rủi ro sớm hơn nhiều.

vocab.meaning_vi: hạn chế về nguồn lực, thiếu người hoặc thiếu ngân sách
vocab.example: We finished the project despite a serious resource constraint.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi hoàn thành dự án dù gặp hạn chế nguồn lực nghiêm trọng.

vocab.meaning_vi: phối hợp chặt chẽ với ai đó
vocab.example: I worked closely with two designers for three months on that portal.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi phối hợp chặt chẽ với hai bạn thiết kế trong ba tháng ở cổng thông tin đó.

vocab.meaning_vi: mang lại giá trị thực cho khách hàng hoặc công ty
vocab.example: I always ask how my work can deliver value to real users.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi luôn tự hỏi công việc của mình mang lại giá trị gì cho người dùng thật.

vocab.meaning_vi: tác động thực tế đo được
vocab.example: The real-world impact was thirty percent fewer support calls each month.
vocab.example_vi: Tác động thực tế là số cuộc gọi hỗ trợ giảm ba mươi phần trăm mỗi tháng.

vocab.meaning_vi: phụ trách, chịu trách nhiệm về việc gì
vocab.example: I was in charge of the reporting module from start to finish.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi phụ trách phần báo cáo từ đầu đến cuối.

vocab.meaning_vi: thích nghi nhanh với thay đổi
vocab.example: When the client changed the scope, our team had to adapt quickly.
vocab.example_vi: Khi khách hàng đổi phạm vi công việc, nhóm tôi phải thích nghi rất nhanh.

listening.title: Interview question: tell me about a memorable project

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Nam, could you tell me about a project you still remember clearly?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Last year I was in charge of a customer portal for a retail company.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: What exactly was your role in that project?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I had to lead a team of four developers and work closely with two designers.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Did you face any difficulties during the project?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We had a real resource constraint: one developer left after the second month.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: How did you handle that situation?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We had to adapt quickly, so I cut small features and protected the main flow.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: And what was the final result of the project?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We launched on time, and the real-world impact was thirty percent fewer support calls.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: What are the lessons learned from that experience?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I learned to plan for risk early and to deliver value in every sprint.

questions.q: What was Nam's role in the project?
options: He led a team of four developers

questions.q: What difficulty did the team face?
options: The office moved to another city

questions.q: What was the result after the launch?
options: Support calls dropped by thirty percent
The project was delayed six months
The team grew to twenty people

shadowing: The project I remember most is a customer portal I led last year.
I was in charge of planning, and I worked closely with two designers.
We faced a resource constraint, so I cut features and protected the main flow.
As a result, support calls dropped by thirty percent in the first quarter.
The main lesson learned was to plan for risk before the project starts.
